name: USDD
oneLiner: USDD is the Tron DAO Reserve's CDP-and-PSM stablecoin, designed as overcollateralized but historically traded below peg through multiple stress episodes.
collateral: Current reserves are split across Smart Allocator stablecoin deployments, TRX and sTRX CDP vault collateral, and USDT held in PSM/direct vaults; Bitcoin was removed from reserves in August 2024
pegMechanism: Governed CDP collateral ratios vary by vault type; the Tron TRX-A, TRX-B, and TRX-C minimum ratios are 1.20, 1.17, and 1.30 respectively; Peg Stability Module enables 1:1 minting/redemption against USDT and USDC

proofOfReserves.provider: TRON DAO Reserve USDD data dashboard (client-rendered live collateral-ratio page; cadence aligned with the susdd sibling record)

notices.title: Legacy reserve governance and USDD 2.0 split
notices.message: Legacy USDD (USDDOLD) depegged near $0.93 in March 2023 and saw roughly 12,000 BTC removed from Tron DAO Reserve collateral in August 2024 without prior DAO vote. USDD 2.0 launched in January 2025 with user vaults and a PSM, while USDDOLD stays circulating with an open migration path.
